https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374230/Flame_Keeper

The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here! Flame Keeper is blazing out of early access and into full release with version 1.0! Get ready to ignite your gaming spirit as we introduce the Prophet, a wise villager who's seen more than a few winters and will guide you through the new Cloud biome, where you'll find icy islands that make winter wonderlands look like beach vacations. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/

Experience conveyor belt mayhem like never before, tackle the challenges of the factory floor, from operating and fixing malfunctioning machinery to navigating treacherous obstacles and prepare for the upcoming Let’s Party Update, which brings seven new minigames to the factory on June 28th.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/

The Wild West Map has just hit town, and it's a real humdinger! We're talking 5 diverse regions to explore, each with its unique flavor. From the dusty saloons to the treacherous oil fields, there's somethin' for everyone!

notes.title: A small patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone! PyroMind's dev here. I've just submitted a small update to the game. Most of the things changed or fixed are points that players reported to me, and some suggestions I received through their feedback. Therefore, I would like to thank you all, especially @Loliwo for kindly reporting these issues. And here are the changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Final boss for the Battle Arena made easier.[/b] Some players noticed that the final boss for the Battle Arena is too hard, thus I made him a bit easier. Still quite challenging.
[*] [b]Achievement fixes.[/b] There were some inaccuracies left in the descriptions and titles of Steam achievements. I hope I fixed these.
[*] [b]Missions renamed to Tiers[/b] This is perhaps the most important change. One thing I noticed while reading through players' feedback is that they had a bit inaccurate expectation of the game being a completionist one, as opposed to high score arcade. It seems that this is mostly caused by the naming of levels as 'Missions', that is something that has to be complete to get to the game's end. While there's an endgame (well, a sort of), PyroMind is mostly a high score oriented game, that employs a mixed model of levels and endless play. Essentially, the player through difficulties as opposed to stages, and in no way the game expects a mid-skilled player to get to the end. Therefore, I renamed 'Missions' to 'Tiers' to better convey this idea.  
[/list]
